applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term, audit job number and audit type (final, interim, revision, non-compliant)
Each GL exposure: class code, location/state, basis type (payroll, sales, area, units), estimated and audited basis
Whether Products-Completed Operations applies; limits (each occurrence / aggregate)
Expected premium and direction vs premium shown
Mid-term changes (class added/removed, location or limit change) and dates; keyed by auditor or automation; screenshots
title: Unexpected premium on a GL endorsement (exposure, class or limit change)
symptoms: Premium delta out of proportion to the exposure, class or limit change on a GL endorsement
cause: Re-rating applies ILF, minimum premium, Products-Completed Operations or modifiers differently from new business, or rates the changed exposure from the wrong date.
diagnosis: Export rating worksheets before and after the change
Compare exposure by exposure: basis, divisor, rate, ILF, modifiers, minimums
resolution: Correct the rate, ILF or class configuration and re-quote
workaround: Manual premium override, if the product allows, with approval.
permanent_fix: Rate configuration fix plus regression test.
